questionText:
Arrange the procedural steps followed by an Internal Complaints Committee (ICC) upon receiving a workplace harassment complaint:
(A) Receipt of written complaint from the aggrieved woman within the statutory time limit
(B) Exploring conciliation option if requested by the aggrieved woman before formal inquiry
(C) Conducting formal, confidential inquiry into the complaint adhering to principles of natural justice
(D) Submitting inquiry report with findings and recommendations to the employer within 10 days of completion

Choose the correct chronological/logical sequence from the options given below:

options.text: D, B, C, A

According to NCERT principles for Work, Livelihood and Career (Resolution Sequence under POSH Act 2013):
A, B, C, D

Detailed Context:
POSH procedure follows: complaint filing (A) -> optional conciliation (B) -> formal inquiry (C) -> report submission to management (D).
Hence Option C is correct.

Therefore, option (B) is the correct answer.

questionText:
Match the ergonomic risk factor in List I with its corrective ergonomic solution in List II:

List I:
(A) Repetitive wrist bending
(B) Screen glare and eye strain
(C) Prolonged static standing
(D) Lumbar spine strain from sitting

List II:
(I) Ergonomic wrist rest and neutral keyboard alignment
(II) Anti-glare screen filters and indirect diffused task lighting
(III) Anti-fatigue cushioned floor mats and footrests
(IV) Adjustable chair with dedicated lumbar curvature support

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:
